name: Sure-Web
description: Sure is a community-driven fork of the former Maybe Finance application, continuing its mission to help users manage personal finances by tracking expenses, budgeting, and supporting wealth management. Note: "Maybe" is a trademark of Maybe Finance, Inc.. This is the 1 of 2 containers required to run Sure finance; **please review the additional requirements.** After Installing: To ensure correct user permissions for the app-storage folder, run 'chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/sure/app-storage' after the initial startup.

paths.name: Config data
paths.description: Config data for application. Should be the same dir as Sure Worker.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Secret key. Run `openssl rand -hex 64` to generate a secret

variables.name: Redis - URL
variables.description: The Redis host URL. Suggested: redis://{YOUR-REDIS-IP}:6379/1

variables.name: OpenAI API Token
variables.description: Optional - NOTE: enabling OpenAI will incur costs when you use AI-related features in the app (chat, rules). Make sure you have set appropriate spend limits on your account before adding this.

variables.name: Is Self-Hosted
variables.description: Is the application self-hosted. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Enforce SSL
variables.description: Enforce SSL connections. Not recommended to change.

variables.description: Assume SSL connections. Not recommended to change.
